exposure: Medications used before or during pregnancy
cohort: 62 pregnancies in 56 liver transplant recipients and 14 pregnancies in 14 cardiothoracic transplant recipients in the United Kingdom, between January 2007 and January 2012
finding: While pregnancy in transplant recipients can have successful outcomes, complication rates are high, with liver transplant recipients experiencing better fetal outcomes, fewer caesarean deliveries, and fewer ICU admissions compared to cardiothoracic transplant recipients.
mod_finding: Liver transplant recipients had fewer caesarean deliveries compared to cardiothoracic transplant recipients (47% vs. 62%).
gest_age: Liver transplant recipients: median 38 weeks, Cardiothoracic transplant recipients: median 35 weeks
birth_weight: Liver transplant recipients: median 2698 g, Cardiothoracic transplant recipients: median 2365 g
